name: Yamaska National Park
policyReason: Leashed dogs are allowed on two trails (La Forestière, La Rivière) year-round, two campgrounds and picnic areas.
summary: Leashed dogs are allowed on two trails (La Forestière, La Rivière) year-round, two campgrounds and picnic areas.

excerpts.quote: Les chiens sont admis dans le parc.
L'accès des chiens est cependant limité à certains endroits, selon certaines conditions.

dogRules.text: Trails (summer and winter): La Forestière and La Rivière.
Campgrounds Les Grives and Les Bruants; picnic areas near the rental centre and P2.
Dogs allowed in boats at the beach rental centre; personal boats only at Savage-Mills.
